column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker tenant-isolation regression tests run one function per dialect (tenant_isolation_mysql_test.go:33, tenant_isolation_mssql_test.go:62) rather than one function with per-dialect subtests, so each name is its own skip rather than a subtest match -- same shape as a-plugin-start-workflow-is-tenant-scoped.tsv beside this file. This job supplies PostgreSQL only (CLEAT_TEST_DB), so the MySQL and SQL Server functions skip and the PostgreSQL tenant-isolation tests run. Both guards deliberately FAIL rather than skip when their DSN IS set but the server is unreachable, so this skip can only mean "this job has no such dialect" -- it cannot be hiding a dead server. Measured: 2, in this job own CI report.
